problem: After the summer, the allotment's roll of wire was mostly used up, leaving just 46 metres. This spring the gardeners bought 38 metres more. How much wire is on the roll now?
follow_up_questions: They use 25 metres to fence off the bean patch. How many metres of wire remain?
Then 30 metres go around the compost heap. How much wire is still on the roll?

problem: How many metres of ribbon does the craft shop have now, if the Christmas rush left only 46 metres and a new delivery added 38 metres?
follow_up_questions: A customer buys 25 metres for a wedding. How much ribbon remains?
Another 30 metres are wrapped around gift boxes. What length of ribbon is left now?

problem: Lena's recipe book had 64 pages until she glued in extra pages of family recipes. Now it has 88 pages. How many pages of family recipes did she glue in?
follow_up_questions: A copy shop prints 4 pages on each sheet of paper. How many sheets does it take to print the whole book once?
Lena wants 3 copies for her aunts. How many sheets will that take?
The copier has 50 sheets loaded. How many more sheets must be added to finish the job?

problem: How many pages of maps were added to the hiking guide? Before the maps went in, it had 64 pages, and the finished guide has 88.
follow_up_questions: Each sheet of paper holds 4 pages of the guide. How many sheets make up one guide?
The hiking club orders 3 guides. How many sheets do they need?
Only 50 sheets are in the printer. How many more sheets have to go in?

problem: Some cyclists were waiting at the ferry dock. A club of 23 riders rolled up behind them, and then 41 cyclists were waiting. How many cyclists were at the dock before the club arrived?
What was the number of ducks on the pond before a flock of 23 landed? Once they had landed, 41 ducks were swimming there.
Mrs. Patel poured 9 jugs of water into the paddling pool, and now it holds 25 jugs. How many jugs of water were in the pool before she started?
follow_up_questions: The pool holds 40 jugs when it is full. How many more jugs can go in?

problem: The grain bin now holds 25 sacks of wheat, because a farmer has just tipped in 9 sacks. Find how many sacks it held beforehand.
follow_up_questions: A full bin takes 40 sacks. How many more sacks can the farmer tip in?

problem: Before her team showed up, Maya swam some lengths of the pool. Once they arrived she swam 27 more, finishing practice with 63 lengths. How many lengths did Maya swim by herself?
follow_up_questions: Lucas swam 18 fewer lengths than Maya's total for the practice. How many lengths did Lucas swim?

problem: What number of pages did Kenji read on the bus? He read some there, then 27 more at home, and that made 63 pages of his comic for the day.
follow_up_questions: His friend Ana read 18 pages fewer than Kenji's total for the day. How many pages did Ana read?

problem: Amara baked some cookies in the morning. In the afternoon she baked 6 more, and by evening she had baked 14 in all. How many cookies did she bake in the morning?
follow_up_questions: Her brother Jonah baked twice as many cookies as Amara's total for the day. How many did Jonah bake?

problem: At the end of the fishing trip, Grandpa had caught 14 fish. He caught 6 of them after the rain stopped. What number of fish did he catch while it was still raining?
follow_up_questions: Uncle Rafael caught double Grandpa's total. How many fish did Uncle Rafael catch?

problem: There were 42 tulip bulbs in the ground along the school fence after Mateo planted 15 of them. The fence is 60 metres long. How many bulbs had been planted before Mateo started?
follow_up_questions: Then Zoe plants 9 more bulbs. How many bulbs are in the ground now?

problem: How many stickers were on the class chart before Ravi stuck on his 15? The chart is 60 centimetres tall, and it has 42 stickers on it now.
follow_up_questions: Lily adds 9 more stickers after that. How many stickers does the chart have now?

problem: Kwame's paper chain grew 12 centimetres longer when he added more links, and altogether it is now 30 centimetres. How long was the chain before?
A sunflower is 30 centimetres tall altogether after growing 12 more centimetres this week. What was its height at the start of the week?

A baking contest lasted 70 minutes from start to finish. The last cake to go in the oven baked for 25 minutes and came out right at the end. The judges wore white aprons. For how many minutes had the contest been running when the last cake went in?
follow_up_questions: After the contest, the bakers spent 15 minutes cleaning the kitchen. How long was it from the start of the contest until the kitchen was clean?
The bakers had arrived 10 minutes before the contest started. How long were they in the kitchen altogether?

problem: How many minutes had passed before the last event of the swim meet started? The meet lasted 70 minutes in all, and that last event, a diving round, took 25 minutes. The pool smelled of chlorine.
follow_up_questions: Then the swimmers needed 15 minutes to get changed. How long was it from the start of the meet until everyone had changed?
They had warmed up for 10 minutes before the meet began. How long were they at the pool in total?

problem: Just 6 apples were left in the fruit bowl, so Rosa went to the market and added 7 more. How many apples are in the bowl now?
How many crayons does the box hold now? Only 6 were left in it, and then Tariq found 7 more under his desk and dropped them in.
Tom heaved a 17-kilogram sack of potatoes onto the market cart. Then the cart carried 50 kilograms of potatoes. How many kilograms of potatoes were on the cart before?
follow_up_questions: The cart can carry 80 kilograms. How much more can be loaded onto it?

problem: With a 17-kilogram bag of leaves just added, the compost bin now holds 50 kilograms. What weight was in the bin before the bag went in?
follow_up_questions: The bin is full at 80 kilograms. How many more kilograms will fit?

problem: The first half of the football match lasted 38 minutes and the second half lasted 27 minutes. How many minutes of football did the fans see?
follow_up_questions: Half-time was 15 minutes long. How long was it from kick-off to the final whistle?
The teams warmed up for 10 minutes before kick-off. How long did the whole event take?
The pitch was booked for 99 minutes. How many minutes were left to clear up afterwards?

problem: How long did the class spend walking on their nature trip? They walked 38 minutes to the lake and then 27 minutes along the shore.
follow_up_questions: They stopped for a 15-minute snack between the two walks. How long was the trip including the snack?
Before setting off, they spent 10 minutes putting on their boots. How long did everything take?
The teacher had planned 99 minutes for the outing. How many minutes were left over?

problem: For the 5-act puppet show there were 70 cushions on the gym floor, after volunteers brought in 24 more. How many cushions had been on the floor before?
follow_up_questions: Only 58 children sat down. How many cushions were left empty?

problem: How many benches stood in the park before the rangers brought 24 more for the picnic? Afterwards there were 70 benches, and the picnic started at 5 o'clock.
follow_up_questions: Families filled 58 of the benches. How many benches stayed empty?

problem: The tree house rope ladder once had 7 rungs. Dad tied on extra rungs, and now it has 12. How many rungs did he tie on?
follow_up_questions: Zara climbs the ladder 3 times. How many rungs does she climb?
Her cousin climbs it only twice. How many fewer rungs does her cousin climb than Zara?

problem: Find how many stairs were added to the garden staircase: it had 7 stairs, and since the new terrace was built it has 12.
follow_up_questions: Omar runs up the staircase 3 times. How many stairs does he run up?
His grandmother walks up it twice. How many fewer stairs does she climb than Omar?

problem: The art class sewed 29 extra centimetres onto the fair banner so every name would fit. Before that, it was going to be 68 centimetres long. How long is the banner now?
What is the length of the scarf now? Gran meant to stop knitting at 68 centimetres, but it looked too short, so she knitted 29 centimetres more.

When school started, the rain gauge in the yard showed 34 millimetres. By home time it showed 61 millimetres. The playground was full of puddles. How many millimetres of rain fell during the school day?
follow_up_questions: That night another 18 millimetres fell. What did the gauge show then?
Mr. Lee poured out 25 millimetres to check the gauge was working. What does it show now?
The gauge at the next school showed 9 millimetres less than this one now shows. What did that gauge show?

problem: Find how much the sunflower grew from Monday to Friday. It measured 34 centimetres on Monday and 61 centimetres on Friday. Its leaves were as big as plates.
follow_up_questions: By the next Friday it had grown 18 centimetres more. How tall was it then?
A storm snapped 25 centimetres off the top. How tall is it now?
Jamal's sunflower is 9 centimetres shorter than this one is now. How tall is Jamal's sunflower?

problem: Anika's necklace string holds 60 beads now. The last 26 beads went on this morning. How many beads had she threaded on before this morning?
follow_up_questions: Her friend gives her 15 more beads, and she threads them all on. How many beads are on the string now?
The string snaps, and every bead except 8 rolls away. How many beads roll away?

problem: How many toy cars stood in Leo's parade line before he added 26 more? Now there are 60 cars in the line.
follow_up_questions: His grandma brings 15 more cars, and he puts them all in the parade. How many cars are in the line now?
The cat knocks over every car except 8. How many cars get knocked over?

problem: Malia's fish-shaped kite weighs 73 grams now that it has a tail and a long ribbon. Without them it weighed 48 grams. She flies it at the beach. How much do the tail and ribbon weigh together?
What is the weight of the buttons Ollie sewed onto his puppet? The puppet weighed 48 grams before he sewed them on and 73 grams after. The puppet is a green frog.
Grandad's garden bench wobbled, so he drove 14 more screws into it. It had been held together by 19 screws. How many screws does the bench have now?
follow_up_questions: Later he took out 6 rusty screws. How many screws are left in the bench?
A picnic table uses 9 more screws than the bench has now. How many screws does the table use?

problem: How many beads are on Lucy's bracelet now? It had nineteen, and at the craft fair she threaded on 14 more.
follow_up_questions: Then 6 beads fell off. How many beads are still on the bracelet?
Her sister's bracelet has 9 more beads than Lucy's has now. How many beads are on her sister's bracelet?

problem: Ants kept marching onto the family's picnic blanket, so they dragged it away from the anthill. It had been 35 metres from the anthill, and now it is 52. How much farther away is it?
How many metres farther from the shore did the boat drift? It was anchored 35 metres out, and after the storm it was 52 metres out.
The cider press held 26 kilograms of apples once Mr. Ahmed had tipped in his 9 kilograms. The apples were red and green. How many kilograms were in the press before he tipped his in?
follow_up_questions: Next, Mrs. Brown adds 12 kilograms. How much is in the press now?

problem: How many bags were in the charity shop's donation pile before the Garcia family dropped off 9 more? After they did, the pile had 26 bags. The bags were stuffed with winter coats.
follow_up_questions: Then the Nguyen family brings 12 bags. How many bags are in the pile now?

problem: For the spring concert, 7 new singers joined the school choir, which already had 18 children. What is the size of the choir now?
follow_up_questions: Each singer needs a song folder, and 16 folders are ready. How many folders still need to be made?
Each folder takes 4 minutes to make. How many minutes will the remaining folders take?
The music teacher has 50 minutes before practice. How many minutes will be left over?

problem: How many players are on the football team now? There were eighteen, and 7 new players joined after the trials.
follow_up_questions: Every player needs a shirt, and 16 shirts have been printed. How many shirts are still to print?
Printing one shirt takes 4 minutes. How many minutes will the rest take?
The print shop closes in 50 minutes. How many minutes will be spare?

problem: The stadium had 75 fans in their seats after a train brought 32 more through the gates. How many fans were seated before the train came?
follow_up_questions: At half-time, 12 fans went home. How many stayed for the second half?
During the second half, 9 more fans came in. How many fans saw the end of the game?

problem: Find how many people were already on the boat before the school group of 32 climbed aboard. With the group, there were 75 people on the boat.
follow_up_questions: At the first stop, 12 people got off. How many stayed on?
At the next stop, 9 people got on. How many people were on board then?

problem: The children taped 15 metres of extra tail onto the class's paper dragon, which had been 23 metres long. What is the dragon's length for the parade?
follow_up_questions: A 9-metre piece got wet in the rain and was cut off. How long is the dragon after that?

problem: What is the length of the farmer's fence now? It was 23 metres long, and he built 15 metres more along the field.
follow_up_questions: A storm knocked down 9 metres of it. How long is the standing fence now?

problem: Park staff added 25 metres to the running track around the duck pond. It used to be 37 metres long. What length is the track now?
follow_up_questions: Lena runs the track 4 times. How many metres does she run?
Her friend Kim runs it 3 times. How many metres do the two girls run altogether?
How many more metres did Lena run than Kim?

problem: How long is the water slide now? It was 37 metres long, and this summer the water park added 25 metres to it.
follow_up_questions: Diego slides down it 4 times. How many metres does he slide?
His brother Pablo slides down 3 times. How far do the two boys slide altogether?
How much farther did Diego slide than Pablo?

problem: Aiyana's canoe trip was 83 metres long. The last 46 metres she simply drifted down the stream; the rest she paddled across the lake. How many metres did she paddle?
What distance did the snail crawl along the fence? After the fence, it crawled 46 centimetres down the wall, and its whole journey was 83 centimetres.
The restaurant's rice bin holds 71 kilograms now. The cook tipped in 4 bags this morning, and before that it held only 26 kilograms. How much rice did the bags add?
follow_up_questions: At lunch, 38 kilograms were cooked. How much rice was left in the bin?
At dinner another 15 kilograms were cooked. How much was left then?

problem: How many litres of water did the firefighters pump into their tank? Before, it had 26 litres; they used 4 hoses, and afterwards it had 71 litres.
follow_up_questions: They sprayed 38 litres on a bonfire. How much water was left in the tank?
Later they sprayed another 15 litres. What was left after that?

problem: By bedtime on a snowy Sunday, Ravi had solved 81 puzzles in his new puzzle book. At lunchtime the count had been 29. How many puzzles did he solve after lunch?
follow_up_questions: The book has 96 puzzles. How many are left to solve?
He solves the rest in 3 equal sessions. How many puzzles does he solve in each session?
Each puzzle takes him 2 minutes. How long is one session?

problem: How many photos did Grace stick in after lunch? On a rainy day she was filling her photo album: 29 photos were in by lunch, and 81 by dinner.
follow_up_questions: The album has room for 96 photos. How many spaces are left?
She fills the rest in 3 equal goes next weekend. How many photos does she stick in each go?
Each photo takes her 2 minutes. How many minutes does one go take?

problem: Hiro iced the last 13 cupcakes for the party, which brought the number on the table to 31. How many cupcakes were already on the table before he started icing?
follow_up_questions: Then 5 cupcakes slid off onto the floor. How many are still on the table?

problem: How many paper lanterns hung in the hall before Mei hung hers? Now 31 lanterns hang there, and Mei hung the final 13.
follow_up_questions: Then 5 lanterns fell down in a draught. How many are still hanging?

problem: After a 20-minute pump, the village water tower held 80 tonnes of water. The pump had added 35 tonnes. How much water was in the tower before the pump started?
follow_up_questions: The village used 28 tonnes that morning. How many tonnes remained?

problem: How many spoonfuls of honey were in the jar before the beekeeper topped it up? She spent 20 minutes adding 35 spoonfuls, and then the jar held 80 spoonfuls.
follow_up_questions: Her family eats 28 spoonfuls that week. How many spoonfuls are left?

problem: A family gave 35 board games to the toy library, which already had 48. What is the number of board games in the toy library now?
follow_up_questions: Families borrow 27 of them over the summer. How many stay on the shelves?
The shelves have room for 70 games. How many more could fit?
The library buys 2 boxes with 7 games in each and shelves them. How many games are on the shelves now?

problem: How many seed packets does the garden club own now? It had 48 in its tin, and a local shop donated 35 more.
follow_up_questions: Members take 27 packets home to plant. How many are left in the club tin?
The tin holds 70 packets. How many more packets would fit?
The club buys 2 bundles of 7 packets and puts them in the tin. How many packets are in the tin now?

problem: The children built another tower on their sandcastle, making it 28 centimetres taller. Before that it stood 45 centimetres tall. How tall is the sandcastle now?
follow_up_questions: They want it to reach 90 centimetres. How many more centimetres must they build?

problem: Find the height of the leaf pile now: it was 45 centimetres high, and after Dad raked the back garden it grew 28 centimetres taller.
follow_up_questions: The children want a pile 90 centimetres high to jump into. How many more centimetres of leaves are needed?

problem: A farmer left 37 kilograms of carrots at the market stall after lunch, on top of the 58 kilograms she had left there that morning. How many kilograms did she leave at the stall that day?
follow_up_questions: The stall can hold 99 kilograms a day. How many more kilograms could it take today?

problem: How much flour did the delivery van leave at the bakery today? It left 58 kilograms before breakfast and another 37 kilograms after lunch.
follow_up_questions: The bakery's storeroom holds 99 kilograms. How much more flour would fit?

problem: The class quilt is 15 rows long now. When the children began sewing on new rows, it was just 6 rows long. How many rows have they added?
follow_up_questions: Each new row took 3 spools of thread. How many spools did they use?
They started with 30 spools. How many spools are left?

problem: How many metres of new track were laid for the toy railway at the museum? It was 6 metres long and now runs for 15 metres.
follow_up_questions: Each new metre needed 3 packs of sleepers. How many packs were used?
The museum had bought 30 packs. How many packs are left over?

problem: Now the summer reading list has 50 books, after each of the 8 reading groups suggested some new titles. It started with 32 books. How many books were added?
follow_up_questions: The teacher adds 6 more books. How many books are on the list now?

problem: How many minutes of exercises did the coach add to the warm-up? It used to take 32 minutes; after she asked the 8 team captains, it takes 50 minutes.
follow_up_questions: She adds a 6-minute stretch at the end too. How long is the warm-up now?

problem: The bakery sold 82 rolls in total yesterday, and 47 of them went before lunch. How many more rolls were sold after lunch?
follow_up_questions: The baker had made 99 rolls. How many were not sold?

problem: How many more visitors came to the aquarium after the morning? By noon 47 people had come in, and by closing 82 people had visited in total.
follow_up_questions: The aquarium allows 99 visitors a day. How many more could have come?

problem: The climbing wall has holds numbered up to 20 at the top. Arturo had reached hold 11 when his coach shouted to him, and he carried on to the top. How many holds did he climb after the shout?
follow_up_questions: He climbs to the top 4 more times that afternoon. How many holds is that?

problem: How many floors did the lift go up after Nadia got in? She got in on floor 11 and rode all the way to floor 20, the top.
follow_up_questions: Later that week she walks up the stairs from the ground to the top floor 4 times for exercise. How many floors does she climb in all?

problem: In the shooting game Mira scored 9 goals once her family arrived to watch. Before they came she had already scored 16. Her trainers are bright green. What was her total number of goals?
follow_up_questions: Her friend Sam scored 7 fewer goals than Mira. How many did Sam score?
How many goals did the two friends score together?
They want to reach 50 between them. How many more goals do they need?

problem: How many cartwheels did Ayo do in all? He did 16 before the music started and 9 more once it was playing. His socks had stripes on them.
follow_up_questions: His sister Ife did 7 fewer cartwheels than Ayo. How many did Ife do?
What is their combined total of cartwheels?
They hoped to do 50 between them. How many more cartwheels do they need?

problem: Zoe's pillow fort was 42 centimetres high until she stacked 25 centimetres more cushions on top. Zoe is 8. How tall is the fort now?
follow_up_questions: Her dog knocked 13 centimetres off the top. How tall is the fort now?
She then built it 20 centimetres higher. What is its height now?

problem: What height has the beanstalk on the windowsill reached? It was 42 centimetres tall, and in 8 days it grew another 25 centimetres.
follow_up_questions: A caterpillar munched 13 centimetres off the top. How tall is it now?
Over the next weeks it grew 20 centimetres more. How tall is it now?

problem: Kemal filled the fish tank to 95 litres by pouring in 58 litres from the hose. How much water had been in the tank before he started?
How much soup was in the camp's huge pot before the cook added more? She added 58 litres, and the pot then held 95 litres.
Kofi's kite reached 33 metres at its highest. It had been at 19 metres when a strong gust caught it and lifted it the rest of the way. Its tail has 12 ribbons. How many metres did the gust lift it?
follow_up_questions: The wind dropped and it sank 25 metres. How high was it then?
Another breeze lifted it 6 metres. How high was the kite after that breeze?
How many metres below its highest point was it then?

problem: How many metres did the hot-air balloon climb after its second burner was lit? It was at 19 metres when that happened and kept going up to 33 metres. The basket carried 12 sandbags.
follow_up_questions: Then it let out some air and sank 25 metres. What was its height then?
A warm wind pushed it up 6 metres. What height was it after that?
How far below its highest point was the balloon then?

problem: A box of 24 paintbrushes was delivered to the art room, and now it has 61 brushes. How many brushes were there before the delivery?
follow_up_questions: The class takes 15 brushes outside to paint a mural. How many brushes are left in the art room?
The rest are shared equally between 2 classes. How many brushes does each class get?

problem: Now there are 61 books on the class shelf, because a parcel of 24 new books has just arrived. How many books were on the shelf before?
follow_up_questions: Pupils borrow 15 books. How many are still on the shelf?
The books left are split equally between 2 reading corners. How many books go in each corner?

problem: By the end of the warm-up there were 22 dancers in the hall, but only 13 had been there when the class began. The hall has 16 windows. How many dancers arrived late?
follow_up_questions: Each partner dance needs 2 dancers. How many partner dances can happen at once?

problem: How many kayakers joined late? The club owns 16 kayaks; 13 people were on the water at the start, and later there were 22.
follow_up_questions: Each kayak takes 2 people. How many kayaks are needed so that everyone is on the water?

problem: Ana kicked 30 goals at football practice in all, and the first 12 came before the water break. How many goals did she kick after the break?
follow_up_questions: The coach wants 40 goals. How many more must Ana kick?
She kicks them in 2 equal rounds. How many goals are in each round?

problem: How many more push-ups did Jabari do after his first set of 12? He kept going until his count reached 30.
follow_up_questions: His target is 40 push-ups. How many more does he need?
He does them in 2 equal sets. How many are in each set?

problem: Ollie's family went apple picking. They filled crates with 29 kilograms after lunch, having already picked 34 kilograms that morning. The crates were made of wood. How many kilograms of apples did they pick altogether?
What weight of sand did the builders shovel? They moved 34 kilograms before the tea break and 29 kilograms after it. The sand was wet from the rain.
The long party table had 14 plates of sandwiches on it. The waiters brought out 8 more plates from the kitchen. How many plates are on the table now?
follow_up_questions: The guests empty 9 of the plates, and they are taken away. How many plates are still on the table?

problem: How many coats are hanging on the rack now, if 14 were already there and 8 latecomers hung theirs up?
follow_up_questions: At the end, 9 guests take their coats and leave. How many coats are still hanging?

problem: A minibus dropped off 18 children at the swimming pool, and they joined the 26 already queuing at the gate. Entry costs 7 dollars. How many children are in the queue now?
follow_up_questions: The gate opens and 30 children go in. How many are still waiting?
Then 9 more children join the queue. How many are waiting now?

problem: How long is the line at the ice-cream van? First 26 people were in it, then 18 more joined after a football match ended. Each cone costs 3 dollars.
follow_up_questions: The seller serves 30 people. How many are still in line?
Then 9 more people join. How many are in line now?

problem: After 7 more ducks flew down to the pond, there were 19 ducks paddling around the 3 lily pads. How many ducks were on the pond at first?
follow_up_questions: If 5 more ducks land, how many will be paddling?

problem: How many kids were in the sandpit at first? After 7 more climbed in, there were 19 playing beside the 3 buckets.
follow_up_questions: If 5 more kids climb in, how many will be playing in the sandpit?

problem: Hugo lost count of his pages at 18, but his sister saw him read 24 more after that. What is the total number of pages Hugo read?
follow_up_questions: His sister read 50 pages. How many fewer pages did Hugo read?

problem: How many sit-ups did Rania manage? Her coach counted 24 after the point where Rania herself lost count at 18.
follow_up_questions: Her coach did 50 sit-ups. How many fewer did Rania do?

problem: Lina's paper chain is 75 centimetres long now that her grandfather has added some links. It was only 40 centimetres long before. The links come in 5 colours. How much length did Grandfather add?
follow_up_questions: Lina's other chain is 90 centimetres long. How much longer is it than this chain?

problem: How much longer did Dad make the dog's lead? It was 40 centimetres long, and after he tied on a strap it was 75 centimetres. The dog is 5 years old.
follow_up_questions: The neighbour's lead is 90 centimetres long. How much longer is it than the dog's lead now?

problem: The bead curtain Lucia is threading with her grandma has 91 beads altogether by lunchtime. Only 38 of them were on before breakfast. How many more beads went on after breakfast?
follow_up_questions: The finished curtain needs 99 beads. How many beads are still missing?
Her brother finds 5 beads in the rug and threads them on. How many beads still need to be found?

problem: How many more stamps did Kiran stick in after school? Before school he had stuck 38 stamps into his album, and by teatime there were 91 altogether.
follow_up_questions: A full set has 99 stamps. How many stamps are still missing from his album?
His uncle sends 5 of them in a letter, and Kiran sticks them in. How many stamps are still missing?

problem: Dad joined an extension onto the 64-centimetre pipe under the sink, and now the pipe is 92 centimetres long. How long is the extension?
Find the length of the table leaf: with it slotted in, the kitchen table measures 92 centimetres, and without it the table measures 64 centimetres.

The dragon in Kai's story wakes up in the last 26 lines, which he wrote this morning. The whole story for the class magazine is now 74 lines long. Kai's dragon is called Ember. How long was the story before this morning?
follow_up_questions: He crosses out 9 lines that were not needed. How many lines does the story have now?
Then he writes 17 more lines so the dragon can fly. How long is the story now?

problem: How many rows had Grandma knitted on the scarf before today? It has 74 rows now, and 26 of them were knitted today. Her needles are made of bamboo.
follow_up_questions: She pulls out 9 rows that had mistakes. How many rows does the scarf have now?
Then she knits 17 more rows. How many rows does it have now?

problem: The summer art camp ended up with 24 children. 18 of them had signed up by Friday, and the rest signed up on Saturday. How many signed up on Saturday?
follow_up_questions: The children worked in pairs, and each pair shared one easel. How many easels were needed?
The camp owns only 9 easels. How many more easels must it borrow?
Each borrowed easel comes with a box of 32 crayons. How many crayons arrive with the borrowed easels?

problem: How many dancers joined the folk-dance club on Saturday morning? There were 18 names on Friday's list, and the final list showed 24.
follow_up_questions: They danced in pairs, and each pair needed one ribbon pole. How many poles were needed?
The club has 9 poles. How many more poles must it borrow?
Each pole has 32 ribbons. How many ribbons are on the borrowed poles?

problem: Oliver screwed a 39-metre piece onto the end of the garden hose, and now the hose reaches 85 metres. He waters the vegetable beds every evening. How long was the hose before he added the piece?
follow_up_questions: He cuts off 15 metres to use in the greenhouse. How long is the hose now?
The rest is cut into 5 equal pieces for the flower beds. How long is each piece?

problem: How long was Mrs. Wong's washing line before she tied on another 39 metres? Now it stretches 85 metres. She hangs the sheets out on sunny days.
follow_up_questions: She cuts off 15 metres to tie up her tomato plants. How long is the line now?
The rest is cut into 5 equal lengths for her neighbours. How long is each length?

problem: On Monday the class fish tank had 37 litres of water in it. The children topped it up during the week, and by Friday it held 64 litres in all. How many more litres did they add?
How many more litres of paint did the decorators pour into the trough? It held 37 litres at first and 64 litres in all once they had finished.
The coach added 20 minutes of passing practice at the end of training, after the team had already trained for 45 minutes. What was the total length of training that day?
follow_up_questions: The next day they train for 15 minutes less than that. How long is the second session?
What is the total training time over the two days?

problem: How long did the band practise on Monday? They played for 45 minutes, and then the conductor added 20 minutes to work on the last song.
follow_up_questions: On Tuesday they practise 15 minutes less than on Monday. How long is Tuesday's practice?
How many minutes did they practise on the two days altogether?

problem: The puppet theatre sold 56 seats in advance. On the day of the show, another 27 seats were bought at the box office. What is the total number of seats sold?
follow_up_questions: The theatre has 99 seats. How many were not sold?
Just before curtain-up, 6 helpers sat in empty seats. How many seats were still empty?
The helpers did not need tickets. How many people watched the show?

problem: How many runners entered the fun run, if 56 signed up online and 27 signed up on the morning itself?
follow_up_questions: There were 99 race numbers printed. How many numbers were not given out?
At the last minute, 6 parents took spare numbers so they could run too. How many numbers were still unused?
The parents ran for free. How many people ran the race altogether?

problem: The baker had 25 loaves ready when the shop opened, and sixty by lunchtime. How many loaves did she bake during the morning?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon, 48 loaves were sold. How many were left?

problem: How many pancakes did Dad flip while the guests were arriving? Before they came, 25 were stacked on the plate; by the time everyone was there, 60 were ready.
follow_up_questions: The guests ate 48 pancakes. How many were left over?

problem: The hedge along the school field is 81 metres long in all now, after volunteers planted 36 more metres of it this morning. What was its length before this morning?
follow_up_questions: Next week they will plant 14 metres to finish it. How long will the finished hedge be?
Mia jogs along the whole hedge and then 5 metres more to the gate. How far does she jog?

problem: How long was the railway track before the workers added 36 more metres on Tuesday? Now it stretches 81 metres in all.
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday they will add 14 metres to finish it. How long will the finished track be?
A test train runs the whole track and then 5 metres more into the shed. How far does it travel?

problem: Carrying 4 children, a sledge glided 37 metres across the flat snow after sliding 24 metres down the hill. What distance did the sledge cover?
follow_up_questions: Then the children pulled it another 9 metres to the hut. How far did the sledge go altogether?
They pulled it the same way back. What is the total distance there and back?
Their dog ran only half as far as the sledge went there and back. How far did the dog run?

problem: How far did Ines's paper plane fly? It glided 24 metres across the hall and then drifted 37 metres more along the corridor. She had folded it in 4 minutes.
follow_up_questions: Then a draught pushed it 9 metres further to the door. How far had it flown altogether?
Ines threw it back the same way. What is the total distance there and back?
Her friend's plane flew half as far as Ines's plane did there and back. How far did her friend's plane fly?

problem: After picking 17 strawberries from one row, Chloe found 12 more in the next row. How many strawberries does she have left for her lunchbox?
How many marbles does Arjun have left to play with, after he found 17 under the bed and another 12 in his coat pocket?
The teacher poured 38 litres of fresh water into the classroom fish tank, which already held 47 litres. What is the amount of water in the tank now?
follow_up_questions: The tank holds 99 litres when full. How many more litres can go in?
To change some water, the teacher scoops out 5 buckets with 9 litres in each. How much water is left in the tank?

problem: How much water is in the farm's trough now? It held 47 litres before the rain, and the rain added 38 litres.
follow_up_questions: The trough holds 99 litres when it is full. How many more litres can it take?
The farmer fills 5 buckets with 9 litres each for the pigs. How much water is left in the trough?

problem: Ms. Rossi gave out 30 gold stars in total today. The last 11 went to children who did well in the spelling test. How many stars had she given out before the spelling test?
follow_up_questions: She had 40 stars on her sheet this morning. How many are still on the sheet?

problem: How many stickers had the librarian handed out before the last group came in? She gave 11 stickers to that group, and that made 30 for the whole day.
follow_up_questions: Her roll had 40 stickers at the start of the day. How many are still on the roll?

problem: Ade's frisbee flew 57 metres on the first throw. He threw it again from where it landed, and it went 26 metres further. He has practised for 6 weeks. How far from his starting spot did the frisbee end up?
follow_up_questions: The far fence is 99 metres from where Ade first stood. How much farther would the frisbee need to go to reach it?

problem: How far from the start did the toy car end up? Its first push sent it 57 centimetres, and its second push sent it 26 centimetres more from where it had stopped. The car is painted in 6 colours.
follow_up_questions: The finish tape is 99 centimetres from the start. How much farther did the car need to roll?

problem: The baker turned the oven timer up from 15 minutes to 25 minutes because her 7 trays of rolls were not brown yet. By how many minutes did she turn it up?
follow_up_questions: The rolls then baked for 18 minutes. How many minutes were left on the timer?
The timer on the second oven had 4 minutes fewer left. How much time was on the second timer?

problem: How many minutes did the referee add to the match clock? It showed 15 minutes, and after the delay it showed 25. The game was on pitch 7.
follow_up_questions: The teams then played for 18 minutes. How many minutes were left on the clock?
The clock on the other pitch had 4 minutes fewer left. How much time was left on that clock?

problem: Mrs. Diallo filled the class pencil pot from a new pack. The pot held 12 pencils before she started and holds 40 now. How many pencils did she put in?
follow_up_questions: During the art lesson, 7 pencils went missing. How many pencils are left in the pot?

problem: How many pegs did Grandad add to the peg bag? It had 12 pegs, and after he opened a new packet it had 40.
follow_up_questions: On washing day, 7 pegs snapped and were thrown away. How many pegs are left in the bag?

problem: Ivan's ball of rubber bands got heavier when he wrapped on another 47 grams of bands. Now it weighs 93 grams. He keeps it on his desk at school. How many grams did the ball weigh before?
What did the bird-seed bag weigh before Sunday? On Sunday Grandma poured 47 grams of sunflower seeds into it, and it then weighed 93 grams. The birds in her garden love sunflower seeds.
The music teacher added a new song to the class songbook, which now runs to 73 pages. Before, it had 46 pages. Each of the 9 singers will need the new pages. How many pages long is the new song?
follow_up_questions: Each page of the new song takes 2 minutes to sing. How long does the new song last?

problem: How many pages long is the new chapter? Before it was written, Ms. Ito's story had 46 pages; with the chapter, it has 73. She read it aloud to 9 pupils.
follow_up_questions: Reading one page aloud takes 2 minutes. How long does it take to read the new chapter aloud?

problem: The magician's show was meant to end after 47 minutes, but the children begged for more tricks and he did 28 minutes more. His hat was tall and purple. What was the total length of his show?
follow_up_questions: His helpers needed 20 minutes to pack away the props after he finished. How long was it from the start of his show until the helpers were done?

problem: How many minutes did the storyteller talk for? She told stories for 47 minutes, and then, because the children shouted for one more, she went on for 28 minutes. Her chair was covered in cushions.
follow_up_questions: The librarian then spent 20 minutes tidying away the cushions. How long was it from the first story until the tidying was done?

problem: Ruby's swimming card had 13 stickers before summer. Over the summer she earned 9 more. What is the number of stickers on her card now?
follow_up_questions: A new badge needs 30 stickers. How many more stickers does Ruby need?

problem: How many stamps are on Diego's smoothie-bar card now? It had 13 when the month began, and he collected 9 during the month.
follow_up_questions: A free smoothie needs 30 stamps. How many more stamps must Diego collect?

problem: Leo bounced his ball 40 times in the garden. His mum called him in for dinner at bounce 24, but he kept going. How many bounces did he do after she called?
follow_up_questions: His sister bounced the ball 5 more times than Leo. How many times did she bounce it?

problem: How many extra pages did Kemi read? Bedtime came when she had read 24 pages, but her mum let her carry on, and she ended up reading 40 pages.
follow_up_questions: Her cousin read 5 more pages than Kemi. How many pages did her cousin read?

problem: Mateo's marble run was 15 pieces long before he built more at the bottom. Now it is 32 pieces long. His little sister kept stealing the marbles. How much longer is the run now?
How much longer is the bean row in the garden now? Last week Zainab's row was 15 metres long; today it reaches 32 metres. Her boots were covered in mud.
On Sunday Amaya knitted 34 centimetres onto her scarf, which had been 52 centimetres long on Saturday. What is the length of the scarf now?
follow_up_questions: She wants the scarf to be 99 centimetres long. How much more does she need to knit?

problem: How long is the kite's tail now? Before break it measured 52 centimetres, and the class glued on 34 centimetres more after break.
follow_up_questions: They want the tail to stretch across the classroom wall, which is 99 centimetres wide. How much more tail do they need?

problem: The teachers are laying ribbon along the hall for a sports day track. They used 27 metres for the first bend and then 58 metres more for the straight. The track has 8 lanes. How much ribbon have they used so far?
follow_up_questions: The finishing line needs 14 metres more. How much ribbon is used after that?
The ribbon came on 3 rolls of equal length, and it has all been used. How long was each roll?

problem: How much string have the scouts used for their trail? They tied 27 metres from the camp to the oak tree and 58 metres more from the oak tree to the stream. The trail has 8 markers.
follow_up_questions: Reaching the bridge takes 14 metres more. How much string is used then?
The string came in 3 equal balls, and now it is all used up. How long was each ball?

problem: After turning the corner of the garden wall, an ant marched another 17 centimetres. Before the corner it had marched 32 centimetres. How far did the ant march along the wall in all?
follow_up_questions: The wall is 60 centimetres long. How much wall is still ahead of the ant?

problem: How far did the toy train go along its track? It ran 32 centimetres before the bend and 17 centimetres after it.
follow_up_questions: The whole track is 60 centimetres long. How much track is still ahead of the train?

problem: The school concert usually has 6 songs, but this year the choir is adding four extra songs. How many songs will this year's concert have?
follow_up_questions: Each of the 15 choir members needs a song sheet for every song. How many song sheets is that?
Some members already know the words, so 30 fewer song sheets were printed than planned. How many sheets were printed?

problem: How many pages does this week's class newsletter have? It normally has 6 pages, and 4 pages of drawings were added this week.
follow_up_questions: Ms. Kaur prints a copy for each of her 15 pupils. How many pages does she print?
Some pupils share with a brother or sister, so she prints 30 fewer pages than planned. How many pages does she print?

problem: Jamal's reading chart has 15 stickers at the end of term, but in March it had only 7. He sits at table 3. How many stickers has he added since March?
follow_up_questions: He read for 9 minutes to earn each of those stickers. How many minutes of reading earned them?

problem: How many charms did Sofia add to her bracelet after her birthday? She had 7 charms on it by her birthday and 15 by the end of the year. The bracelet was a gift from her 3 cousins.
follow_up_questions: Each new charm cost 9 dollars. How much did the new charms cost?

problem: Dad's suitcase weighs 35 kilograms now that it is packed with clothes. Empty, it weighed 12 kilograms. What do the clothes weigh?
follow_up_questions: Mum's suitcase weighs 8 kilograms more than Dad's packed one. How much does Mum's weigh?
What do the two suitcases weigh together?

problem: How much did Ama's shopping weigh? Her empty trolley weighed 12 kilograms, and with all the shopping inside it weighed 35 kilograms.
follow_up_questions: Her neighbour's full trolley weighs 8 kilograms more than Ama's. How much does it weigh?
How much do both full trolleys weigh together?

problem: There are 39 books in total on the book week display now that the librarian has added 14 more. How many books were on it before she added them?
How many cones were on the pitch before the coach set out 14 more for the drills? Now there are 39 cones in total.
Mr. Silva pinned extra drawings onto the class board. It had 18 before and has 26 altogether now. How many more drawings did he pin up?
follow_up_questions: Next week, 5 old drawings will be taken down. How many drawings will be on the board then?
The board has space for 30 drawings. How many more could go up after that?
Mr. Silva asks each group to make 3 new drawings, so that he gets exactly that many. How many groups does he ask?

problem: How many more fridge magnets did Dalia stick on? The fridge had 18 magnets, and now it has 26 altogether.
follow_up_questions: Next week she will take 5 old magnets off. How many magnets will be on the fridge then?
The fridge door has room for 30 magnets. How many more could fit after that?
She buys exactly that many new magnets in packs of 3. How many packs does she buy?

problem: After a short rest, Kofi bounced a football on his knee 20 more times. Before the rest he had managed 35 bounces without dropping it. His football is black and white. How many bounces did he do in all?
follow_up_questions: His friend Ben did 9 fewer bounces than Kofi. How many bounces did Ben do?

problem: How many times did Aiko hop on one leg? First she hopped 35 times without stopping, and after a drink of water she hopped 20 more. Her shoes had flashing lights.
follow_up_questions: Her friend Mei hopped 9 fewer times than Aiko. How many times did Mei hop?

problem: The animal shelf in the school library holds 45 books now. The librarian put 18 of them there this morning. How many books were on the shelf before this morning?
follow_up_questions: Each class borrows 9 books. How many classes can borrow from the full shelf?

problem: How many eggs were in the farm shop's basket before Ana added the 18 she collected from the hens? The basket now holds 45 eggs.
follow_up_questions: Each customer buys 9 eggs. How many customers can the full basket serve?

problem: The library's book-sale box ended the day with $96 in it. It had $37 in the morning, then the parents' group added $24 from selling cakes, and later shoppers paid the rest. The box was painted to look like a treasure chest. How much did the later shoppers pay?
follow_up_questions: The head teacher then added the same amount as the later shoppers paid. How much was in the box after that?
New shelves cost $75. How much money is left after paying for them?

problem: How much did the afternoon visitors give to the zoo's penguin appeal? The collection tin held $37 in the morning, a scout troop added $24, and by closing, after the afternoon visitors, it held $96. The tin was shaped like a penguin.
follow_up_questions: The zoo then added an amount equal to what the afternoon visitors gave. How much was in the tin then?
A new slide for the penguin pool costs $75. How much is left after buying it?

problem: Omar's uncle paid him $25 for washing the car. Omar still had $14 left over from buying a book at the fair. How much money does he have now?
follow_up_questions: He buys a model plane for $17. How much money does he have after that?
The next week he earns $8 more for raking leaves. What is his total now?
A kite costs $35. How much more does Omar need to buy it?

problem: How much money does Sana have now? She had $14 left over from her trip to the toy shop, and then her neighbour paid her $25 for feeding the cat.
follow_up_questions: She spends $17 on a jigsaw puzzle. How much money is left?
A week later she gets $8 more for walking the neighbour's dog. How much does she have now?
A set of roller skates costs $35. How much more does she need?

problem: Ella has 30 arcade tokens now, after her grandma handed her 12 more. The racing game costs 3 tokens a go. How many tokens did Ella have before?
How many stickers did Rohan have before his teacher handed him 12 more? He now has 30 stickers, and he sticks 3 on each page of his book.
The Owls quiz team scored 15 points in the picture round. Before that round they had 26 points. What was their score once the picture round was over?
follow_up_questions: The Foxes team finished with 50 points. How many points ahead of the Owls were the Foxes?
Then the Owls won the music round for 12 more points. What was their score after that?

problem: How many points did the Green dragons have after the obstacle course? They had 26 points at the morning break of the school games, and the obstacle course earned them 15 more.
follow_up_questions: The Red lions ended with 50 points. How far ahead of the Green dragons were they?
The Green dragons then won the sack race for 12 more points. What was their score then?

problem: Now there is $99 in the class trip fund. It had $58 before the parents gave $27 and the head teacher made a gift as well. What was the head teacher's gift?
follow_up_questions: The trip costs $40 more than the fund has now. How much does the trip cost?

problem: How much did the cafe give to the animal shelter's appeal? The appeal started with $58, a running club gave $27, the cafe gave the rest, and now the total stands at $99.
follow_up_questions: The shelter still needs $40 to reach its target. What is the target?

problem: Talia's apple basket held 23 apples by the end of the day. She had picked 9 of them before lunch. How many did she pick after lunch?
follow_up_questions: Apples at the orchard cost $3 each. How much will Talia pay for all the apples in her basket?

problem: How many shells did Benji find in the afternoon? He found 9 in the morning, and by sunset his bucket held 23 shells.
follow_up_questions: Benji paints every shell in his bucket and sells them for $3 each. How much money does he make?

problem: Mr. Kumar sold $38 of lemonade before noon and $57 after noon. His tin already held $45 when the stand opened, and the stand has 4 stools. How much was in the tin at closing time?
How much money was in the museum gift shop's till when it closed? It opened with $45, sold $38 of postcards in the morning, and sold $57 of toys in the afternoon. The shop has 4 shelves of books.
The school disco raised $75 in all. Ticket sales brought in some of it, and the snack table brought in $32 more. How much came from tickets?
follow_up_questions: The money goes toward a new sound system that costs $90. How much more does the school need?
A parent gives $9. How much does the school still need?

problem: How much did the library's book sale make on Saturday, if it made $32 more on Sunday and raised $75 in all over the weekend?
follow_up_questions: The money is for new beanbags that cost $90. How much more does the library need?
A reader donates $9. How much does the library still need?

problem: A parent brought 8 comics into class and added them to the 17 already in the reading corner. The corner has a big red rug. What is the number of comics in the reading corner now?
follow_up_questions: The teacher took 6 comics to the other classroom. How many comics stayed in the reading corner?

problem: How many teddy bears sit on the toy shop's shelf now? There were 17, and the owner unpacked 8 more. The shop smells of fresh paint.
follow_up_questions: A family bought 6 of the bears. How many bears are left on the shelf?

problem: By Tuesday evening the barn held 90 bales of hay. It had 36 bales at the start of the week, and a tractor brought 25 bales on Monday. The rest arrived on Tuesday. How many bales arrived on Tuesday?
How many boxes did the second van bring to the school hall? The hall had 36 boxes of books, the first van brought 25, and once the second van had been unloaded there were 90 boxes.
Games at the fun fair cost $2 a go, and they added $34 to the class charity jar. The jar had held $23 before the fair. What does the jar hold now?
follow_up_questions: On Monday the jar gets $19 more. What is the total now?
The class wants $90 to adopt a zoo animal. How much more must it raise?

problem: How much money is in the swimming club's tin after the gala? It had $23 before, and at the gala the club sold drinks for $2 each, adding $34.
follow_up_questions: The next morning parents put in $19 more. What does the tin hold now?
The club needs $90 for new lane ropes. How much more must it collect?

problem: There are 50 oranges in the fruit stall's crate now. Before Kiran unloaded the fresh ones from the truck, it held 28. How many fresh oranges did he add?
follow_up_questions: He packs all the oranges into bags of 5 and sells each bag for $9. How much money does he get for all the bags?

problem: How many plums did Grandma add to the bowl? It had 28 plums, and after she picked more from the tree it had 50.
follow_up_questions: She packs all the plums into bags of 5 and sells each bag for $9 at the market. How much money does she get for all the bags?

problem: There are 39 pallets in the warehouse now, after a forklift brought in 14 of them. How many pallets were inside before the forklift started?
follow_up_questions: The warehouse can hold 45 pallets. How many more pallets can the forklift bring in?
The forklift carries 2 pallets at a time. How many trips is that?

problem: How many logs were stacked by the cabin before Papa carried in 14 more? Now the stack has 39 logs.
follow_up_questions: The stack needs 45 logs for winter. How many more must he carry?
He carries 2 logs at a time. How many trips will that take?

problem: The librarian added 38 books to the new section in the morning and 46 in the afternoon. There were 45 books in it to start with. The library cat slept on the windowsill. How many books are in the new section now?
follow_up_questions: Tomorrow she will add 24 more books. How many books will the section have then?

problem: How many tiles cover the bathroom wall now? It already had 45 tiles; the tiler fixed 38 in the morning and 46 in the afternoon. The radio played all day.
follow_up_questions: Tomorrow he will fix 24 more tiles. How many tiles will be on the wall then?

problem: A coach dropped off 19 more people at the beach, and then there were 46 people altogether. How many people had been on the beach before the coach?
How many letters were in the school's post tray before the caretaker added 19 more? Altogether the tray now has 46 letters.
At the book fair Tobias had $32 after his mum topped up the $15 he had brought. The fair has 8 tables of books. How much did his mum add?
follow_up_questions: He buys a big atlas for $12. How much money does he have left?
Then he buys 4 bookmarks at $3 each. How much money is left now?
His mum gives him $10 more for a comic. How much does he have now?

problem: How much did Grandpa give Meera at the zoo? She arrived with $15, and after his gift she had $32. The zoo has 8 lions.
follow_up_questions: She spends $12 on a toy giraffe. How much is left?
Then she buys 4 bags of animal food at $3 each. How much money is left now?
Grandpa hands her $10 more for an ice cream. How much does she have now?

problem: The school bake sale had raised $57 by break time. After break, parents spent $28 on cakes and the teachers spent $19 on cookies. How much did the bake sale raise altogether?
follow_up_questions: The money is shared equally between 4 classes. How much does each class get?

problem: Find the total raised by the swimathon: swimmers collected $57 in the morning and $28 in the afternoon, and the coaches' race added $19.
follow_up_questions: It is shared equally between 4 clubs. How much does each club get?

problem: At the farm show, Juan's calf weighed 52 kilograms. Back in winter it had weighed 38 kilograms. How much weight had it put on since winter?
follow_up_questions: The biggest calf at the show weighed 61 kilograms. How much heavier was it than Juan's?
Juan's calf puts on 3 kilograms a month. What will it weigh 2 months after the show?

problem: How many kilograms did Lily's dog gain over the year? It weighed 38 kilograms last spring and 52 kilograms at its check-up this spring.
follow_up_questions: The largest dog at the vet's that day weighed 61 kilograms. How much heavier was it than Lily's dog?
Lily's dog gains 3 kilograms a month. What will it weigh 2 months after the check-up?

problem: The summer camp coach counted 42 footballs after families donated 15 of them. How many footballs did the camp own before the donation?
follow_up_questions: The footballs are shared equally among 6 groups. How many does each group get?
Each group loses 2 footballs over the fence. How many does each group have left?

problem: How many paintbrushes were in the art cupboard before the teacher unpacked a new set of 15? Now there are 42 in the cupboard.
follow_up_questions: They are shared equally among 6 tables. How many brushes does each table get?
Each table breaks 2 brushes. How many brushes does each table have left?

problem: Readers raised $49 in the second week of the library's sponsored read, after raising $64 in the first week. Each reader read 5 books. The money is for a new reading tent. What was the total raised?
follow_up_questions: The reading tent costs $95. How much money is left after buying it?

problem: How much did the school's car wash raise for a new bench? Pupils raised $64 on Saturday and another $49 on Sunday, working in 5 teams.
follow_up_questions: The bench costs $95. How much money is left over after buying it?

problem: Matteo has $30 in his wallet now, thanks to the prize he won in the library's drawing competition. Before the competition he had only $12. His mum took a photo of him with his drawing. How much was the prize worth?
How much did Amira's prize for the spelling bee come to? She had $12 saved before the bee and $30 afterwards. Her teacher clapped the loudest.
By lunch the bakery's cash drawer held $85. Of that, $47 came from selling bread that morning, and the rest was there before the shop opened. How much was in the drawer at opening time?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon a birthday cake order paid $60. How much is in the drawer now?
The baker takes out $45 to pay for the flour delivery. How much stays in the drawer?
She splits what is left into 4 equal bags for the bank. How much goes in each bag?

problem: How much money was in the ice-cream van's tin when the day began? By lunchtime, after $47 of ice-cream sales, the tin held $85.
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon a school trip spent $60. How much is in the tin now?
The driver takes out $45 to pay for petrol. How much is left in the tin?
He shares what is left equally between 4 envelopes. How much goes in each envelope?

problem: The supermarket's charity box reached a total of $61 after shoppers dropped in $26 more on Monday. How much was in the box before Monday?
follow_up_questions: On Tuesday the box got another $14. What is in the box now?
The money is spent on books for the hospital at $5 each. How many books can be bought?

problem: How much was in the museum's donation jar before Sunday, if visitors added $26 more on Sunday and the jar then held a total of $61?
follow_up_questions: On Monday another $14 went in. How much is in the jar now?
The museum spends all of it on fossil kits at $5 each. How many kits can it buy?

problem: In the end the scouts' recycling tin held $93. It had started with $29, a shop paid $18 for a sack of cans, and the rest came from neighbours' bottles. How much did the bottles earn?
follow_up_questions: The scouts split the money equally between 3 camps. How much does each camp get?

problem: How much did the morning dog walks earn for the animal shelter? The shelter's jar had $29, the walks added some money, a vet then gave $18, and at the end the jar held $93.
follow_up_questions: The shelter shares the money equally among 3 animal rooms. How much does each room get?

problem: The truck already carried 32 crates of apples when Mrs. Chen lifted 19 more onto it. The market is 4 kilometres away. How many crates are on the truck now?
follow_up_questions: At the market, 25 crates are unloaded. How many are still on the truck?

problem: How many chairs are in the hall now? The caretaker had set out 32 chairs and then wheeled in 19 more on a trolley with 4 wheels.
follow_up_questions: After the show, 25 chairs are stacked away. How many chairs are still set out?

problem: Tomas washed cars and earned $28, which he added to the $45 already in his savings jar. He is saving for a skateboard. How much is in the jar now?
follow_up_questions: The skateboard costs $89. How much more does Tomas need?
His aunt gives him $20. How much money does he have now?
He buys the $89 skateboard. How much money does he have left?

problem: How much has Priya saved for her keyboard so far? She had $45 in the bank and has just earned $28 more babysitting.
follow_up_questions: The keyboard at the music shop costs $89. How much more does Priya need?
Her grandmother gives her $20. How much does she have now?
She pays $89 for the keyboard. How much is left?

problem: The library returns box had 37 books in it when the library opened. Readers dropped in 28 books before noon. More were dropped in after noon, and at closing the box held 92 books. How many books were returned after noon?
How many jars of jam did Gran make on Sunday? Her shelf held 37 jars on Friday, Saturday's batch added 28, and after Sunday's batch it held 92.
Hamza's savings came to a total of $25 once his grandma added $9. He is saving for a football. How much had he saved by himself?
follow_up_questions: The football costs $30. How much more does he need?
He walks 2 dogs for a neighbour and earns $3 for each dog. How much money does he have now?

problem: How much had Elif saved on her own before her sister added $9? With her sister's money, Elif's savings for a sketchbook totalled $25.
follow_up_questions: The sketchbook costs $30. How much more does she need?
She waters 2 gardens for neighbours and earns $3 for each one. How much money does she have now?

problem: Nadia's domino snake has 35 dominoes now. She set up the first 18, and her brother set up the rest. The kitchen clock ticked loudly. How many dominoes did her brother set up?
follow_up_questions: Then the cat knocked them over, and 9 dominoes slid under the fridge. How many dominoes could they still find?

problem: How many cards did Max add to the card house? His friend Jo built it with 18 cards, and after Max's turn it had 35 cards. It was raining outside.
follow_up_questions: Then the card house collapsed, and 9 cards slid under the rug. How many cards could they still find?

problem: Nurses held a bucket collection outside the hospital. Visitors gave $76 on Monday and $58 on Tuesday. What was the total for the two days?
follow_up_questions: The head nurse adds $46 from a quiz night. How much do they have now?
